hero_subtitle: A licensed Moroccan copper asset supported by field evidence, laboratory assays, and a preliminary mine construction and processing orientation study.
short_description: Atlas Mining offers a structured operating entry pathway into the Isseksi copper opportunity, supported by a 180-day feasibility upgrade plan and an optional digital validation system designed to reduce blind exploration and support disciplined pilot decisions.
core_statement: Atlas Mining controls a licensed copper asset with preliminary field, laboratory, and engineering evidence, now structured for intelligent validation and operating entry.

three_scale_view.base: Base orientation case — subject to validation (2.3 Mt @ 1.8% Cu hypothesis; 800 t/day scenario; 124.4M MAD HT preliminary CAPEX).
three_scale_view.upside: Upside case — not yet resource-classified (larger mineralized system potential; possible Cu/Zn extension; qualitative only).
three_scale_view.expansion: Expansion case — requires feasibility and engineering validation (selective pilot → modular processing → staged production → plant decision → long-term agreement).
